blocks.text: Vice Ganda said the Philippines is the only country in Asia to receive a second season of “LOL: Last One Laughing,” citing the strong performance of the comedy competition’s first installment as the show prepares for its return. “Siyempre, sobrang excited kasi ang trivia, ang Philippines lang ang binigyan ng second season sa whole Asia,” she said during a media conference on Tuesday, Oct. 27. The comedian said the success of the first season raised expectations for its follow-up, so they are in a position to deliver a better second installment.
